claim: Creating a new workspace file silently truncates and overwrites any existing file at the same path to 0 bytes because neither FilesystemView nor the workspace file save endpoint checks whether the target file already exists.
evidence: Nemofy Agent/src/components/FilesystemView.tsx:162-166 implements the 'New file' creation flow by calling saveWorkspaceFile(clean, '') directly without checking whether clean already exists in tree or passing a create-only flag. On the backend, PUT /api/filesystem/file calls writeWorkspaceFile in server/configStore.ts, which writes content directly via fs.writeFileSync without O_EXCL / exclusive creation semantics. After truncating an existing file, line 164 shows 'Created file /workspace/<clean>'.
runtimeTrigger: A user opens the Workspace Filesystem view, clicks 'New file', and enters the relative path of an existing file (such as notes.md or src/app.py). handleCreateSubmit calls saveWorkspaceFile(clean, ''), silently wiping the existing file's contents to an empty string with no confirmation or conflict error.
